headline: Gold Climbs to $4,137 Ahead of Federal Reserve Decision
summary: Gold prices advanced to $4,137.94 after an early decline, while the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield ticked up to 5.13% and Brent oil pared earlier intraday gains.
why: Gold is a widely watched safe-haven asset and inflation hedge. Shifts in U.S. interest rate expectations and Treasury yields heavily influence precious metal pricing.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Positioning ahead of the Federal Reserve rate announcement lifted gold above $4,137.

why_moved: Gold rebounded from early session losses as market participants adjusted positions ahead of the Federal Reserve's policy announcement.
